dossier.form: Stocky knight in plain plate with one oversized tower shield.
dossier.decision: Choose which ally stands behind the shield.
dossier.positioning: Front row, facing the expected attackers, carry directly behind.
dossier.allies: Any fragile Mage, Sniper or Priest.
dossier.counterplay: Flank the shield or push him away from the protected ally.
dossier.recognition: The big shield glows and a short arc marks the guarded side.

ability.name: Shield Wall
ability.tooltip_en: Passively reduces eligible incoming attacks aimed at the one ally standing behind his guarded side.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengurangi serangan yang mengarah ke satu rekan di belakang sisi perisainya. Serang dari samping atau pisahkan mereka.

dossier.form: Big-shouldered orc with tusks, a boar-skull helm and a heavy club.
dossier.decision: Build a long run-up into a big first hit.
dossier.positioning: Far from the target with an open lane.
dossier.allies: Orcs for health; Fighters for damage.
dossier.counterplay: Screen or crowd the lane; block the landing cell.
dossier.recognition: Dust trail grows with momentum, then a streak on the charge.

ability.name: Tusk Charge
ability.tooltip_en: Movement builds momentum; a clear straight path triggers a charge that turns momentum into a heavy hit.
ability.tooltip_id: Bergerak mengumpulkan momentum; jalur lurus yang kosong memicu serudukan yang mengubah momentum menjadi pukulan berat.

dossier.form: Antlered elf elder in a leaf mantle with a twisted wooden staff.
dossier.decision: Anchor a healing zone the team fights inside.
dossier.positioning: Centre of the formation, where she will not need to walk.
dossier.allies: Tanks and Fighters who hold ground next to her.
dossier.counterplay: Burst her before the grove establishes, or displace her.
dossier.recognition: A ring of flowers grows on the healed cells and pulses.

ability.name: Sacred Grove
ability.tooltip_en: After standing still, establishes a pulsing healing area; moving, displacement, stun or defeat breaks it.
ability.tooltip_id: Setelah diam, menciptakan area penyembuhan berdenyut. Bergerak, terdorong, pingsan, atau kalah akan memutusnya.

dossier.form: Wiry goblin with a metal jaw-guard and a hooked chain.
dossier.decision: Reach a distant enemy unless something stands in the way.
dossier.positioning: On a line with an unscreened enemy carry.
dossier.allies: Assassins; units that open lanes by pushing.
dossier.counterplay: Put a defender in the line.
dossier.recognition: The chain line is shown before the hook flies.

ability.name: Chain Hook
ability.tooltip_en: Commits toward a distant enemy and hits the first enemy the straight line meets.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyerang ke arah musuh jauh dan mengenai musuh pertama yang dilewati garis lurus.

dossier.form: Slim scholar in a long coat carrying a large floating crystal.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies lined up in rows and columns.
dossier.positioning: Protected back row with a clear view of the enemy cluster.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer in front; Mages for the skill-damage bonus.
dossier.counterplay: Spread across rows and columns; interrupt the unreleased cast.
dossier.recognition: The crystal splits light into a visible cross before each beam fires.

ability.name: Crossfire
ability.tooltip_en: Locks a crossing point, then releases a row beam followed by a column beam.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengunci titik silang, lalu melepaskan sinar baris disusul sinar kolom.

dossier.form: Water-bodied figure with a wave-shaped crest and trailing droplets.
dossier.decision: Break a formation by pushing its front unit away.
dossier.positioning: On the lane holding the enemy's key front-liner.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer's counter; allies that punish displaced units.
dossier.counterplay: Stagger the formation; block the push cell.
dossier.recognition: A wave rolls down the lane and carries one enemy back.

ability.name: Tidal Wave
ability.tooltip_en: Damages enemies in the facing lane and pushes the first enemy back through free cells.
ability.tooltip_id: Melukai musuh di jalur depan dan mendorong musuh pertama ke belakang melalui petak kosong.

dossier.form: Thin horned demon carrying a hanging iron cage on a chain.
dossier.decision: Take one enemy out of the fight.
dossier.positioning: Behind a defender, within reach of approaching enemies.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer; allies that focus the caged unit.
dossier.counterplay: Interrupt the wind-up; pressure him during the long cooldown.
dossier.recognition: The cage flies out and closes around one enemy.

ability.name: Soul Cage
ability.tooltip_en: Fires a cage at one enemy; on impact it cannot move, attack or cast for a short time. No damage.
ability.tooltip_id: Menembakkan kurungan ke satu musuh; sasaran tidak dapat bergerak, menyerang, atau memakai kemampuan sesaat. Tanpa kerusakan.

dossier.form: Robed cleric with a tall hood and a large lantern staff.
dossier.decision: Keep one key ally alive through burst.
dossier.positioning: Back row, away from Assassin landing cells.
dossier.counterplay: Dive her with Assassins or silence her.
dossier.recognition: A beam of light links the lantern to the healed ally.

ability.name: Mending Light
ability.tooltip_en: Heals the allied unit with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyembuhkan rekan dengan nyawa paling rendah.

dossier.form: Short broad dwarf with a braided beard and a huge two-handed hammer.
dossier.decision: Lock down the unit in front of him.
dossier.positioning: Front row opposite a dangerous melee enemy.
dossier.allies: Dwarves for shields; Fighters for damage.
dossier.recognition: The hammer glows, then an impact star appears over the target.

ability.name: Stunning Blow
ability.tooltip_en: Strikes the current target and stuns it briefly.
ability.tooltip_id: Memukul sasaran saat ini dan membuatnya pingsan sesaat.

dossier.form: Massive orc with stone gauntlets and a single shoulder plate.
dossier.decision: Stop a melee pile-up around him.
dossier.counterplay: Do not surround him; use ranged units.
dossier.recognition: Raised fists, then cracks spread to adjacent cells.

ability.name: Ground Slam
ability.tooltip_en: Slams the ground and stuns all adjacent enemies.
ability.tooltip_id: Menghantam tanah dan membuat semua musuh di sebelahnya pingsan.

dossier.form: Round bear-headed bruiser with huge paws and a leather harness.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies that cluster around him.
dossier.counterplay: Fight him one at a time or from range.
dossier.recognition: A wide claw arc sweeps around him.

ability.name: Wide Swipe
ability.tooltip_en: Hits every adjacent enemy with one swipe.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengenai semua musuh di sebelahnya dengan satu sapuan.

dossier.form: Tiny green goblin with big ears carrying a round bomb as large as his torso.
dossier.recognition: A lit fuse, an arc, and a small blast circle.

ability.name: Lobbed Bomb
ability.tooltip_en: Throws a bomb that damages a small area around the target.
ability.tooltip_id: Melempar bom yang melukai area kecil di sekitar sasaran.

dossier.form: Small floating flame spirit with two round eyes and tiny arms.
dossier.recognition: A warm bubble surrounds the shielded ally.

ability.name: Warm Ward
ability.tooltip_en: Places a small shield on the ally with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Memberi perisai kecil pada rekan dengan nyawa paling rendah.

dossier.form: Heavy orc with painted arms beating a large waist drum.
dossier.decision: Speed up a melee group at the right moment.
dossier.positioning: Just behind the front line, next to Fighters.
dossier.counterplay: Kill the buffed group's back support; stun during the buff.
dossier.recognition: Red rings pulse out from the drum.

ability.name: War Drum
ability.tooltip_en: Raises the attack speed of nearby allies for a few seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Menaikkan kecepatan serang rekan di sekitarnya selama beberapa detik.
